title: Organizing Your Lead Pipeline — A Cost-Effective Starting Point
content:
###  **Most Companies Have More Leads Than They Realize** 

It is common for a company to have interested homeowners scattered across texts, voicemails, and sticky notes — real interest that never gets tracked in one place, let alone followed up on consistently. 

###  **The First Fix Is Often the Cheapest** 

Before any advanced system is needed, simply organizing existing leads into one place — with notes on what each homeowner said and when to follow up — recovers a surprising amount of lost opportunity. 

###  **What This Looks Like in Practice** 

A simple, low-cost tracking approach: every homeowner conversation logged, a follow-up date attached, and a consistent process for checking back in rather than relying on memory. 

###  **Where SIT™ Fits In Right Now** 

We can help clients set this system up in a way that is cost-effective and easy to maintain — a practical step that pays for itself quickly, ahead of any larger nurturing service.
